'''Sheryc Seka''' was a [[Yarkora/Legends|Yarkora]] [[Thief/Legends|thief]] and [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]]. She maintained a professional relationship with the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Salmakk]], who provided her with many rare weapons. She often split her time between Salmakk's base and the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Darlyn Boda/Legends|Darlyn Boda]], in particular the restaurant [[Pepper's Pax]], looking out for business opportunities. Years later, during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], both her business and reputation suffered due to her decision not to work with the [[Peace Brigade]].
